verdicts.reason: A shrinks the bottle to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the top-right corner against the decorative circle, so the key product image is lost. Its headline is crammed against the bottom-left edge, and the legal line is set as large as the offer copy, so it competes with the message. B keeps the bottle as a readable centrepiece and groups the headline, copy, CTA and legal text in a tidy right-hand column. However, B's logo and sale ribbon are undersized and float in a mostly empty left half, and its headline sits too close to the top edge.
